sources.carto:atlantic: Cartographic anchor in open Atlantic water inside the viewer extent. The Wikipedia Atlantic Ocean point (0, -25) is mid-ocean and is not used.
sources.carto:obx: Cartographic anchor for the Outer Banks as a region: mid-barrier chain, just east of Pea Island / Rodanthe. The Wikipedia 'Outer Banks' point (35.233, -75.530) coincides with Cape Hatteras and would collide with that cape label; it is not used. The banks run roughly from the Virginia line to Ocracoke / Portsmouth.
sources.carto:crystal: Crystal Coast is the Carteret County coast, including Bogue Banks (Atlantic Beach to Emerald Isle) and the Beaufort / Morehead City waterfront. Label placed mid-Bogue Banks so it represents that coastal reach rather than a single town. Wikipedia 'Crystal Coast' point (34.695, -76.709), near Morehead City / Atlantic Beach, confirms the region; the label is shifted west along Bogue Banks within that extent.
sources.carto:raleigh: Raleigh Bay is the Atlantic bight between Cape Hatteras and Cape Lookout (standard coastal-geography sense; NOAA chart coverage of that bight). The Wikipedia 'Raleigh Bay' point (35.023, -75.988) sits at Ocracoke Inlet, too far inshore/west for a bay label. Anchor placed in open water of that bight.
